Implemented the missing API in src/lib.rs (only file changed; tests untouched):
- `ShapeError` enum with `Empty`, `Ragged { row, expected, found }`, `Mismatch { left, right }` variants (derives Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq) plus a `Display` impl.
